description: A byte-identical redelivery of an already-recorded inbound message returns ALREADY_RECORDED and mutates nothing.
why_it_exists: Gmail redelivers. An earlier harness compared summary, classification and a regenerated communication_id - all downstream products - so every ordinary retry was reported as a conflict. The fingerprint is therefore computed only from stable ingress fields (pmid, thread, sender, subject, raw body, provider timestamp) before classification runs.

communications_register.subject: Re: [MAT-QA-001] round trip
communications_register.ingress_fingerprint: <computed by ingressFingerprint(EV_FIRST); recompute, do not hard-code>

expect.ingress_fingerprint_spec: ingressFingerprint(e) = 'ING-' + fnv1a32(parts) + '-' + canon(e.body).length, where parts = ['pmid=' + trim(pmid), 'thread=' + trim(thread_id), 'from=' + emailOf(from), 'subject=' + canon(subject), 'body=' + canon(body), 'ts=' + trim(received_at)].join(' '); canon collapses all whitespace runs to a single space and trims; emailOf extracts the address inside angle brackets and lowercases it; fnv1a32 is a single 32-bit FNV-1a pass (offset basis 0x811c9dc5) rendered as 8 lowercase hex characters.
expect.note: The stored fingerprint on the fixture row must be recomputed with ingressFingerprint(EV_FIRST) before the case runs; it is intentionally not hard-coded so a change to the hash function fails loudly rather than silently.
expect.reason_shape: Already recorded, raw message identical. Ignored.
expect._correction_2026-08-25: Two corrections. (1) expect.stored_fingerprint was the prose "equals the incoming ingress_fingerprint"; replaced by REGENERATE, resolved through harness/oracles.js. (2) expect.reason was the paraphrase "Already recorded, raw message identical. Ignored."; the node emits "Message <id> is already recorded on <matter> and the raw message is identical. Ignored." The paraphrase was never an oracle from the QA workflow, so it is demoted to reason_shape (informational). decision, basis, event_id, event_type and severity are unchanged and still asserted.

assertions: A prior INBOUND row is located by provider_message_id, not by idempotency_key or by content.
When the stored fingerprint equals the recomputed fingerprint the decision is ALREADY_RECORDED with severity INFO and requires_human_review false.
communication_id returned on replay is the stored value and is identical to the value returned on first delivery.
event_id is 'EVT-REPLAY-' + provider_message_id, distinct from the first-delivery event id, so the replay audit row cannot overwrite the NEW_INBOUND audit row.
No field of the stored Communications row is proposed for change.
